entries.comment:
•For tariff heading 1301 reduced rate applies only on mastic (white or not) raw
•For tariff headings 1512,1515 reduced rate applies only on soybean oil, peanut oil, sunflower oil, cotton oil (cottonseed oil), corn oil, sesame oil and their fractions, whether or not refined but not chemically transformed
•For tariff heading 1516 reduced rate applies only on edible mixtures or preparations of animal fats or oils or vegetable or from fractions of various fats or oils of Chapter 15

entries.comment:
Food for human consumption, excluding food supplied for catering, is taxed at 0% (exempt with credit) (part 4).  

The above exemption does not apply to items classified under the following subheadings in the First Schedule of the Import Duties Act:

(1) 1515.90.15.00;1515.90.15.90;1515.90.21.00; 1515.90.31.00;1515.90.40.00;1515.90.60.00; 1516.20.10.00; 1517.90.93; 1521.90.10.00

(2) 2006.00.10; 2009

(3) 2105.00; 2106.90.20.00; 2106.90.98.33; 2106.90.98.37; 2106.90.98.39

(4) 2307.00
